qt: to the Commission Loucas Fourlas (PPE) Subject:

Every day, there are cases of fires breaking out in vehicles travelling on European roads. Often, by the time the fire service arrives, the fire has already spread, resulting in the total destruction of the vehicle and, above all, seriously increasing the risk of injury or death among drivers, passengers and other road users. At the same time, such incidents can have a serious impact on traffic and create secondary risks. Given that an immediate response to a fire in the first critical minutes can limit its spread and contribute to the protection of human lives and property, and bearing in mind that the relevant requirements differ from one Member State to another, can the Commission say: Will it consider a corresponding legislative initiative with a view to improving road safety and preventing vehicle fires?
